requirements.description: Bind exact SN74LVC1G11DBVR and 100nF 0402; retain decoupling role and 2mm positive-land distance constraint. Native macro binding must match exact footprints and supply nets.
Host must connect IC pin2 to continuous ground planes locally. Inspect actual IC-ground-to-capacitor-via return; this partial macro owns only capacitor ground.
Require native filled-board DRC, bypass surface verification, plane connectivity and 0.5mm additional courtyard gap; no switch/load current through local bypass branch.
Verify rail transient/noise margin, switching interference and logic behavior in the actual assembled consumer; fixture clearance is not qualification.
